user.title: Bestiarium Climate
user.description: Configure capacity and timing for heating/cooling device rotation.

data_description.capacity: How many devices can run simultaneously (0–100)
data_description.min_working_time: Minimum time a device must run before rotation
data_description.recovery_timeout: How long to wait before retrying a non-responding switch

reconfigure.title: Reconfigure Bestiarium Climate
reconfigure.description: Update the timing settings. The capacity is changed with the Capacity entity (for example by a power automation); the setup form gives only its initial value.

error.invalid_min_power: Minimum power must be a number

user.title: Add Virtual Switch
user.description: Configure a virtual switch with heating/cooling and off actions, and power monitoring.

data.name: Name
data.min_power: Minimum power (W) to treat device as on

data_description.name: Friendly name for this switch
data_description.mode: Whether this switch is used for heating or cooling
data_description.heating_action: Action to run when switch is turned on in heating mode
data_description.cooling_action: Action to run when switch is turned on in cooling mode
data_description.off_action: Action to run when switch is turned off
data_description.min_power: Power above this value is considered "on"

data.name: Name
data.min_power: Minimum power (W) to treat device as on

error.invalid_min_power: Minimum power must be a number

basic.title: Thermostat Settings
basic.description: Configure the temperature sensor, target switch, and tolerances.

data_description.name: Friendly name for this thermostat
data_description.target_switch: Switch entity to control (any switch in Home Assistant)
data_description.thermostat_mode: Whether this thermostat controls heating or cooling
data_description.cold_tolerance: Temperature band below target before turning on
data_description.hot_tolerance: Temperature band above target before turning off

init.title: Switch control
init.description: How the balancer controls the thermostats' switches, for all thermostats of this entry.

data_description.attempts: Balancing cycles (a minute each) a switch may stay unlike the expected state before it is deferred for the recovery timeout
data_description.tolerance_seconds: A switch or temperature sensor gone for less than this is a short dropout, not a problem
data_description.hysteresis_seconds: A problem ends only after this long without it
